en.title: Thailand's tourism market faces peak season as Chinese tourists prepare for Golden Week holidays
en.summary: Thailand is experiencing a surge in travel bookings from Chinese visitors ahead of the Mid-Autumn Festival and National Day holidays. Chinese tourists are booking earlier, extending their stays, and showing increased interest in natural attractions and distinctive cities.

en.title: 2026 International Day of Peace commemorative activities open in Wuhan
en.summary: Commemorative activities for the 2026 International Day of Peace opened in Wuhan on September 21. Over 300 participants from 60 countries attended, including political leaders, peace organizations, think tank scholars, and diplomats.

en.title: Preliminary results released for Russian State Duma elections with United Russia party in dominant position
en.summary: According to preliminary voting results for the ninth Russian State Duma elections released on September 21, the United Russia party secured an overwhelming majority of votes.

en.title: "Shared Time Across the World" cultural tourism series debuts at 2026 ATAS annual conference
en.summary: The 2026 British Association of Travel Suppliers annual conference took place in Northampton on September 21-22, with China serving as the conference's principal partner country.

en.title: Men's 4x200m Freestyle Dramatic Comeback at Aichi Nagoya Asian Games; Chinese Swimming Team Wins 5 Golds on the Day
en.summary: Swimming competitions at the Aichi Nagoya Asian Games took place at the Tokyo Aquatics Center, with seven gold medals awarded. China's swimming team claimed five gold medals, four silver medals, and two bronze medals that day.

stories.title: Gaza children return to in-person schools for first time in 3 years

en.title: Gaza children return to in-person schools for first time in 3 years
en.summary: Hundreds of thousands of Gaza's children have resumed attending school in person after nearly three years, though most schools are damaged or operating from temporary structures. Many families cannot afford basic supplies like uniforms and notebooks.

stories.title: First ladies step forward as Trump lays on rare honours for Xi

en.title: First ladies step forward as Trump lays on rare honours for Xi
en.summary: Melania Trump will lead cultural diplomacy events during Chinese President Xi Jinping and his wife Peng Liyuan's official state visit to the White House from September 23-25, their first visit since 2015, featuring ceremonial honours and cultural exchanges.

stories.title: Hong Kong developer New World gets nod to spin off K11 Shanghai assets

en.title: Hong Kong developer New World gets nod to spin off K11 Shanghai assets
en.summary: New World Development received approval from the Shanghai Stock Exchange to spin off and list a real estate investment trust with an expected offering size of 3.82 billion yuan, with the group expecting net proceeds of 3.24 billion yuan.

stories.title: Hong Kong stock exchange moves to ease spin-offs and shareholder approval rules

en.title: Hong Kong stock exchange moves to ease spin-offs and shareholder approval rules
en.summary: The Hong Kong stock exchange proposed relaxing disclosure and shareholder approval requirements for listed companies, including removing profit tests and streamlining spin-off procedures, in a consultation period extending to November 30.

stories.title: How Hong Kong is positioning for a bigger role in Asia’s family wealth transition

en.title: How Hong Kong is positioning for a bigger role in Asia's family wealth transition
en.summary: Hong Kong is strengthening its position as Asia's hub for family business succession and wealth transfer as wealthy families navigate economic uncertainty and generational wealth transitions, according to financial regulators and business executives.

stories.title: Expect ‘high tide’ of Chinese biotech deals as threat of US curbs fades: analysts

en.title: Expect 'high tide' of Chinese biotech deals as threat of US curbs fades: analysts
en.summary: US-China biotech transactions are anticipated to increase significantly as Washington moves away from implementing broad restrictions on such deals. Chinese healthcare companies stand to benefit from this favorable environment combined with Beijing's strategic five-year sector development plan.

stories.title: Asia investors demand AI revenue proof as focus shifts from exposure to earnings: BofA

en.title: Asia investors demand AI revenue proof as focus shifts from exposure to earnings: BofA
en.summary: Asian investors are increasingly requiring concrete evidence that artificial intelligence investments generate actual revenue and earnings rather than merely seeking technology exposure. This shift reflects the sector entering a more mature phase focused on productivity gains and monetization.
